"Here’s a grenade for you, fascist, from a Soviet soldier." - Putin on Russia's response to Ukrainian strikes.

You can really tell how much he wants to end the war and strives for peace, right?
Putin: "I am not saying we are going to strike the countries that supply weapons to Ukraine. But we are watching closely."

At least three explosions have been reported at a chemical plant in Krasnozavodsk, Moscow Region. Seven workers are confirmed dead. One of the workshops has completely collapsed. The plant's primary line of work is the production of weapons and ammunition. https://t.co/nIRnycBzi3
